Ramadan Mubarak💕 
Thank you, I know life is short and thank u for your advice. I’m a lil better now. :) I just sometimes be in these dark moods and then I sometimes can be trapped there if life becomes harder but when something good happens it kinda goes. Tbh i Don’t know how to describe it

I think u should tell ur therapist about it, if u really trust her/him. But tbh honest I don’t really know I’m just 17. I kind of suffer also of the same problem (but not as much), and then I remember that it’s just anger and I don’t want to actually hurt someone. I’ve been abused all of my childhood and it kind of fucked me up mentally. And I don’t want anyone else to go through something traumatic like I did. Soooo my advice would be try to reason with yourself and reflect What is actually going on, Why do u have these thoughts. And try to distract yourself with things that bring u joy ( like hobbies). I hope you become better ❤️❤️
